summary: TRILL uses distribution trees to deliver multi-destination frames, and multiple trees may be used by an ingress RBridge. This proposed standard describes how data labels, such as VLAN or Fine-Grained Label, can be used to choose among those trees so different traffic can be spread across them.

eli5.summary: When many people need to get the same announcement, several delivery routes can share the work. This lets the network pick which route to use based on a label on the traffic.
